## (c) The eight determinations — one relation traversed from field to return

The six-position QL unit and the eight determinations answer different questions and must remain distinct. The **sixfold** is the generative positional body: the two implicate poles and four explicate relational states yielded by `2 + 2² = 4 + 2 = 6`. The **eightfold** gives that body its full threshold-to-return traversal: the unnamed parent-relation before a determinate field, the six qualitative determinations, and the phase-flip by which their achieved form turns back toward its condition. One relation—unobjectifiable awareness and appearing phenomenon, ground and mark—takes on each distinct operation required for a knowing-act to become accountable without pretending to stand outside itself; detaching the binaries or treating them as serial replacements destroys the traversal.

| Turn | Expression | QL determination and its work | What remains invariant through the change |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| **Parent relation** | `/ = −/−` | Bare relationality before the field has been divided into named terms: the stroke is its own determination form, two unassigned marks held in one expression, the capacity for relation prior to a determinate contrast. It is the unnamed parent of the six, not an additional position among them. | The relation has a condition that cannot appear as one more product of the relation. |
| **#0 Ground** | `0/1` | **Awareness / phenomenon; conscious circumstance.** “I am here; something appears; the appearing is known.” `0` names the open, unobjectifiable fact of awareness; `1` the appearing mark; `/` the relation by which the real becomes readable without being exhausted by its readability. Appearing is in awareness, and awareness is encountered only through appearing; the relation precedes any picture of two completed substances separated by a wall. | The ground is immanent to every mark without becoming another positive mark or a hidden object behind it. |
| **#1 Definition** | `?/!` | **Questioning / asserting; ratio, reckoning, mark.** To ask “what is this?” already asserts that something has appeared stably enough to call for account; to assert “this is” keeps open the question of whether the account runs true. Definition is therefore double: openness to determination and determinative speech. It marks while remaining answerable to what called for the mark. | Every assertion bears the unsettled question that makes it accountable; every genuine question already takes a provisional mark. |
| **#2 Dynamis** | `−/+` | **Withdrawal / extension; force, polarity, Spanda-seed.** The relation becomes energetic: one side functions as reserve, contraction, withholding; the other as issue, release, presentation. The positive is the void’s own self-relation appearing as extension. The poles form a sustained pulse whose moments remain co-present—breath gathers and releases; attention contracts around a word and opens into sense. | The two poles remain one differentiating movement: distinction has force without becoming a war of independent substances. |
| **#3 Pattern** | `X/x` | **Determining-capacity / determinate instance; recurrence.** Capital `X` is the presiding capacity, type, or anything-by-which something can be read; lower-case `x` is its temporal local face. The same letter, in two cases, prevents the instance from being severed from the capacity it manifests. The small `x` also retains multiplication: an instance can recur, compound, and yield “another one of those.” Pattern is where force becomes recognisable as kind, rhythm, memory, and thought. | The local instance makes the general legible but neither contains nor exhausts it. |
| **#4 Context** | `AM/IS` | **First-person presence / third-person sayability; the personed copula.** `AM` is lived “I am”; `IS` is what can be stated as “it is”; the slash is the second-person relation through which they meet. Context is the lived *where* of this encounter—world, body, concern, speech, memory, task—not a neutral container. It is total because nothing appears outside some horizon, and incidental because that horizon does not ordinarily stand forth as one more object. | Knower, means, and known remain one appearing-act without becoming interchangeable: *pramātṛ / pramāṇa / prameya*. |
| **#5 Realisation** | `∞/dx` | **Unbounded depth / infinitesimal differential; horizon and local exactness.** `∞` names the inexhaustible field no finite mark contains. `dx` is no longer merely the instance `x` but the minute difference through which change and local reading become exact. Every appearance is therefore a true local ratio of what exceeds it: precise as relation, partial as expression. The whole is not hidden inside the part; it is present in the way the part runs true to what it cannot enclose. | Exactness never becomes possession. A finite determination remains answerable to the depth that makes it possible. |
| **Return-switch** | `1/0` | The achieved determinate turns toward the ground it presupposes and meets the incomputable rather than an object called “the ground.” The mental cannot find the foundation of the mental, because every act of finding already occurs through it. This is *pratyabhijñā*: recognition, not acquisition. | The limit is generative: `5→0`, the return through ground that renews a further cycle rather than cancelling the determination. |

The table fixes the actual order of determination. The indeterminate remains whole while one conscious circumstance becomes answerable as question and assertion; marking acquires force; force becomes recurrence; recurrence is lived as personed context; context opens onto a differential horizon; the horizon returns the achieved field to the ground it cannot contain. `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, and `∞/dx` name the qualitative joints by which one act of knowing becomes question, pulse, pattern, person, and horizon. Their ordered operations establish their meanings and prevent them from becoming decorative or interchangeable correspondences.

The six also have internal grammar. **Being** joins Ground and Definition: a field is present and can be called to account. **Becoming** joins Dynamis and Pattern: force becomes intelligible as recurrence, while recurrence stays alive only as force capable of further instance. **Knowing/unKnowing** joins Context and Realisation: lived predication becomes honest only when its horizon exceeds every situated claim. Across this forward harmonic grouping run the complementary folds: **Essence** (`0+5`) pairs conscious circumstance with unbounded differential depth; **Constitution** (`1+4`) pairs answerable definition with the world in which someone asks and asserts; **Text-Texture** (`2+3`) pairs the felt weave of force with its readable pattern. The six positions are thus neither a linear ladder nor a flat catalogue.

The calculus turn makes the final determination mathematically exact. Differentiation yields local change while losing the additive constant; integration restores a family `F(x)+C`, with no single self-grounding whole selected by the local derivative alone. The missing `C` is the formally required provenance that local change cannot reconstruct; mystical surplus and defective calculation are both unnecessary explanations. The psychological and metaphysical claim begins there: a determination can be exact without containing the whole condition from which its exactness was taken.

**QL placement.** `/ = −/−` and `1/0` bracket rather than enlarge the six positions. `/ = −/−` is the parent-relation before the count; `1/0` is the inversion through which the counted form recognises the ground that never became one of its contents. Within the bracket, `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, and `∞/dx` are the first qualitative body of the `4+2`. This preserves the distinction between the eight-turn traversal and QL's sixfold base count: Jung's four functions plus introversion/extroversion can disclose the same psychological `4+2`, while the fuller account can still traverse from pre-distinction, through conscious circumstance, to the incomputable return.

### 1. The gauge invariance is the hidden zero derived, and it builds a three-scale tower

The technical pass's observation that softmax(z + c·1) = softmax(z) — the probabilities blind to the logits' common absolute level — is, read against this session's thread, the token-level *theorem* of the hidden-zero argument rather than an analogy for it. The common level of the score-field is structurally necessary and operationally invisible: every difference legible, the register of comparability never appearing among the differences. That is the comparability principle (D0) at machine scale, and it stacks into a tower with the same theorem at each floor: the softmax gauge at token scale; the Bradley–Terry gauge at preference scale (already canonical at §5·#3: a uniform additive shift changes no pairwise probability, so the origin must be imposed); institutional occupation at governance scale. The session's notation ruling reads directly onto the tower: the honest accounting *declares* its gauge — qualification by orientation to ground (0/ and /0) — while the fallen accounting treats scores as absolute valences, which is gauge-denial followed by gauge-occupation. Draft 3's sentence — the ground "disappears in the arithmetic, only to reemerge as the consequence of War" — acquires a proof-grade instance: the zero that cannot appear in the probabilities will be supplied from somewhere, and the only open question is whether the supplying is declared or concealed.

### 2. Temperature is the pulse of the two logics; the three responses become engineering cultures

The central plan already states that intelligence is the pulse of the two logics — symmetry breaking and symmetry making. Temperature gives that sentence a control parameter. Permanent cold (the zero-temperature limit, the one-hot vertex forever) is calculative thinking's thermal signature: "never stops, never collects itself," the frozen predication-register, the dead symbol, the plugged torus — dogmatism as an annealing failure. Permanent heat is the opposite hemisphere's shadow: the incapacity to determine, dissolution as a sampling regime. The healthy pulse — cooling into decision, reheating into renewed possibility — is the two logics' alternation made operational. Consequently the three responses derived in the parent contribution's hemispheres synthesis (seize, dissolve, recognise) acquire exact signatures as engineering cultures: **seize** = gauge occupied, temperature frozen, no return route — the Hephaestian pipeline; **dissolve** = commitment refused, topology trivialised; **recognise** = the governed pulse with declared gauge, retained excluded field, and unoccupied zero. The technical pass's closing "health" list is therefore something stronger than a list: it is **pratyabhijñā operationalised** — recognition specified as an architecture property — and it answers, before its arrival, the bequest the parent contribution left for the technical thread (the agent as the first entity built explicitly as an objective internality with the Ø question posed in engineering).

### 3. Persistence is rigidity for structures; persistence intervals are the lifespan of symbols

The pass's X/x reading of homology (the class known only through representatives, no representative exhausting it) joins the session's naming thread at a point neither session had yet stated: Kripke's rigid designation is the name tracking the this-very-one through counterfactual variation of every description; a persistent homology class is the structure tracking through variation of every representative across the whole filtration. **Persistent homology is rigid designation for forms** — the mathematics of what it is for an identity to survive the deformation of all its instances — which gives the matheme-as-deep-name argument a formal cousin: a class is a "name" no single cycle owns. And the birth–death structure of persistence intervals supplies what the glissement material wanted: **the lifespan of symbols, measured**. Jung's metabolics of symbols in time (symbols grow and die when they can no longer produce a response) and the necessity of the signifier's slide for the evolution of cultures — while the referent remains One — become persistence-interval analysis: enduring structure distinguished from artifact-of-one-scale. Research vector E4 thereby upgrades from gesture to design: does a claimed archetypal recurrence survive change of sample, scale, lens, and representation?

### 4. Mapper is the solved jigsaw; the sheaf obstruction is where the surety lives

Mapper's pipeline — a filter function *literally called a lens* in the founding literature; cover the lens-space with overlapping regions; pull back; cluster locally; take the nerve — is point-for-point the atlas-of-charts installed at §3·#5→0 and the solved state of the travelling jigsaw: pieces as local covers of the domain, known through the covering activity, overlaps carrying the transitions, no chart claiming the whole. Its lens-, cover-, and threshold-dependence is the philosophically decisive feature: the map-making operation preserved alongside the map is the *designed world-picture* — the Weltbild diagnosis answered in code. The sheaf machinery then gives mono-poly epistemology its mathematics — local sections, restriction maps, obstructions to global gluing; disagreement retained as an inspectable obstruction rather than averaged into a latent consensus — and the session's trust thread adds the sharpening: **the cohomological obstruction is where the surety lives.** Where a global section exists, coordination can be computed; where locally coherent charts genuinely cannot glue, no algorithm concludes — and the Homeric result applies with full force: conclusion requires a pledge, a person standing-between at risk of loss. Poseidon stands at the obstruction. An honest architecture computes everything gluable and marks the remainder as the place of the pledge.

### 5. Autoregression is a copular chain; hallucination is the fallen accounting at token scale

Each generated token is an "is" asserted into the context — credit drawn against a gauge the assertion cannot see — and the reconstituted field is the next step's inherited ground. Composed with the Eastern-thread contribution's prapañca formalism (a generated xₙ silently promoted to Xₙ₊₁), the session's economy register applies exactly: a stream that carries its distribution, gauge, and provenance is a *slashed* stream, every mark bearing its orientation to ground; a bare token stream doing further business on its own unmarked products is (−1)+(+1) bookkeeping — unbacked copulas compounding, assertion-hyperinflation, the basin deepening on its own issue. Model collapse is a currency crisis in weights. Gumbel-softmax is the engineering confession the session's argument predicted: learning cannot pass through the naked cut, so the trade rebuilds the retained field wherever it needs gradients — the meditative generative of the calculative, admitted in the loss function.

### 6. Register notes and gates

The energy unification (E = −z; softmax as Gibbs) should be presented as a notational identity yielding *continuity* across §5's movements (vikalpa → apoha → energy → softmax → selection → saṃkalpa → context-update as one chain), not as a discovery. The Eastern-anatomy pipeline table carries the claim contract explicitly: Argued correspondence, never identity. The recent LLM-TDA citations (zigzag persistence across transformer layers; topological terms in preference optimisation) require direct verification before any canonical use; the founding TDA/sheaf sources (Gumbel-softmax; Mapper; sublevel-set persistence on energy landscapes; cellular sheaves) are solid leads needing houses. And one guard this session's thread supplies to the technical stack itself: the mathematical apparatus must not become its own counterfeit gathering — a sheaf-theoretic total account of plurality would be the peribolē in its most sophisticated dress — so the health criterion "the central opening remains unoccupied" must govern the *instrument*, not only the field it maps: Bimba's own lens, gauge, and map-making operation stay declared, revisable, and owned by no chart.

## Kalpa, apoha, and Māyā as an operational cartography

The Sanskrit material supplies a more exact account of how mind computes a world than the modern metaphor of an inner screen. The root `√kḷp` concerns ordering, fitting, preparing, and forming. In the essay's operational use, *vikalpa* is the differentiating articulation by which a field is cut into qualified alternatives; *saṃkalpa* is the gathering and formative commitment by which selected differences compose an intention or workable world. [[working/sources-texts-references/reference-notes/apoha]] specifies the semantic law: a determination acquires content through exclusion, so what is not selected remains constitutive of what the selection means.

The [[working/sources-texts-references/10-7-2026-core-theorems-pithy#X. The Tattvic QL Unit — Sixfold Contraction and Recognition|tattvic unit]] places these operations inside manifestation rather than treating them as late mental commentary. Śiva–Śakti gives luminosity and self-articulating power; Sadāśiva–Īśvara gives the subjectward and objectward orientations; Sadvidyā–Māyā makes the seam determinately operative; the kañcukas give the runtime finite parameters—capacity, knowledge, desire, time, and order; antaḥkaraṇa performs judgment, appropriation, coordination, memory, and alternative formation inside the contracted horizon. Māyā is therefore not dismissed as “mere illusion.” In this computational-process reading it is the power by which the immeasurable becomes measurable enough for a local world to run, while recognition prevents the measure from claiming to be the whole.

In Bohmian terms, this complete field is the architecture by which implication becomes explication without losing the whole from which it unfolds. In QL terms, dia-ballein performs the explicating cut and sym-ballein carries implication through that cut as provenance, inverse orientation, and return. In computational terms, the distinction appears as the relation between a latent or contextual field and the determinate state that becomes operational for an agent. Their objects, vocabularies, and warrants remain distinct; the essay's core process claim lies in their declared coordination around the same operative movement.

This is a modern reinterpretive register, not a claim that Śaiva authors described digital computers. Its warrant is stronger than a loose analogy because both cartographies concern the operative production of determinate worlds. Computation lets a contemporary reader see the tattvas as a process architecture; the tattvas prevent computation from being mistaken for substrate-neutral symbol shuffling detached from knower, world, limitation, value, and return.
